segments.text: If you post on more than one network, you know the problem. X wants it short. LinkedIn wants the story. Instagram wants a caption.
So most people either paste the same text everywhere, or rewrite it by hand, every single day.
Cascade is for people who post daily across several networks with Buffer. You write an idea once, Cascade turns it into a post made for each network, and puts them all in Buffer.
We built it because Buffer already solved the posting. The rewriting was still on you.
Here's my day. I post on X and LinkedIn through Buffer. I sign in with Buffer, and my channels are already there.
We just shipped something, so I write it once, in my own words.
I add a screenshot. I can upload it, or paste a link.
Cascade writes a version for each.
X gets a short, punchy post. LinkedIn gets the story behind it. Both fit Buffer's limits.
My words only. No hashtags or emojis I didn't write.
I can tweak anything, or get a fresh version.
For each network I choose: my Buffer queue, a set time, or a draft. For this demo, both go in as drafts.
One tap, and it's all in Buffer. My idea is saved in Buffer Ideas, and each network gets its own post.
Two networks, two audiences, about a minute of work.
Cascade. Write once, fit every network, ready in Buffer.
